per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be easy to use for novice internet users, including those with limited technical skills.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product should be able to be used by 90% of novice users on the Internet.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall allow users to start watching a movie with no more than two clicks after logging in.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Users should be able to access their streaming movies in under 2 clicks after logging into the website.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be usable by at least 90% of novice internet users without external assistance.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product should be able to be used by 90% of novice users on the Internet.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall respond to user actions, such as opening a page or clicking a button, within five seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Any interface between a user and the automated system shall have a maximum response time of 5 seconds unless noted by an exception below.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall initiate movie streaming with no more than ten seconds of buffering.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: When streaming a movie the buffering time should take no longer than 10 seconds (plus any latency on the user's connection.)'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be available 24/7 without scheduled downtime.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall be available for use 24 hours per day 365 days per year.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall have an uptime of at least 99.5%.
The system shall encrypt credit card information and restrict access to authorized personnel only.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide clear and accessible privacy policies and terms of service.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall make its user aware of its information practices before collection data from them via a Privacy Policy accessible on all pages of the website.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall support flexible payment options, including prepaid cards available online and in physical stores.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'When purchasing a streaming movie or pre-paid card via credit card the processing time should have a maximum response time of 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide subtitles and language options to support accessibility for users with different needs.
